title: Core: formalize v1alpha1 CUE schema and manifest discovery
body:
Define formal CUE constraints and implement standalone plus embedded/adjacent manifest discovery. Specify precedence, shadowing, atomic reload, metadata visibility, and actionable diagnostics.

Acceptance: deterministic discovery tests cover conflicts, invalid children, reload failure, and Windows/Unix path forms.

title: Core: build resolver conformance and fuzz suite
body:
Expand exact/longest-prefix coverage into a protocol-neutral conformance suite. Include escaping, encoding, Unicode, traversal, route ambiguity, cancellation, and fuzz cases.

Acceptance: every protocol adapter consumes the same resolver cases without reimplementing matching.

title: Core: stabilize backend capability and error contracts
body:
Define stat, range-read, list, redirect, retry, cancellation, and common-error contracts. Keep credentials outside manifests.

Acceptance: fake backend conformance tests prove capability fallback and error translation.

title: Backend: implement rclone remote adapter
body:
Implement the backend contracts over rclone remotes without modifying Spaceghost/rclone. Decide library, subprocess, or RPC boundary explicitly.

Acceptance: passes the shared backend conformance suite and documents credential/config isolation.

title: Backend: implement HTTP upstream adapter
body:
Implement stat and range reads for HTTP upstreams with redirect safety, conditional requests, bounded retries, and cancellation.

Acceptance: passes the shared backend conformance suite against a deterministic test server.

title: Backend: implement S3 upstream adapter
body:
Implement S3-backed reads and optional presigning using external credential providers.

Acceptance: passes the shared backend conformance suite and a local S3-compatible integration suite.

title: HTTP: serve objects with redirect and proxy policy
body:
Turn resolver results into GET/HEAD/range responses. Honor redirect intent only when the backend can return a safe bounded URL; otherwise proxy.

Acceptance: tests cover ranges, validators, content metadata, method limits, redirects, fallback, cancellation, and upstream error mapping.

title: S3: implement read-only protocol facade
body:
Expose GetObject, HeadObject, and listing semantics over the shared resolver. Define bucket/key mapping and S3 error translation.

Acceptance: AWS SDK integration tests exercise pagination, prefixes, ranges, missing keys, and encoded keys.

title: Cache: implement bounded read-through cache
body:
Specify cache keys, validation, eviction, partial objects, stampede control, and crash cleanup before implementing read-through caching.

Acceptance: deterministic tests cover stale data, concurrent misses, bounds, restart, and bypass.

title: Cache: specify write-through and write-back durability
body:
Write an RFC for commit point, conflicts, retries, queue persistence, fsync boundaries, recovery, visibility, and operator controls.

Acceptance: approved failure matrix and recovery test plan precede executable write support.

title: Desktop: evaluate mount integration and unmount safety
body:
Spike WinFsp/FUSE and possible rclone integration boundaries. Measure enumeration, random/range reads, cancellation, reconnect, and forced unmount.

Acceptance: written recommendation includes benchmark evidence and failure behavior; no production claim from a demo mount.

title: Desktop: design control plane and diagnostics
body:
Design manifest selection, validation, live status, logs, cache controls, credential-provider integration, mount lifecycle, and upgrades.

Acceptance: threat model and UX flows cover invalid manifests, lost upstreams, cache pressure, and safe shutdown.

title: RFC: restricted dynamic route resolution
body:
Compare restricted Lua with alternatives only after the static core is stable. Define CPU, memory, recursion, output, filesystem, network, time/randomness, and observability limits.

Acceptance: scripts can only emit a validated Resolution and cannot perform upstream I/O directly.

title: CI: add protocol integration and compatibility matrix
body:
Extend unit CI with race tests, fuzz smoke tests, local HTTP/S3 fixtures, SDK compatibility, and release artifacts.

Acceptance: required checks have bounded runtime and document which jobs use GitHub-hosted runners.
